reflection.title: Reflection

Public services and student loans draw on that same Cestui Que Vie trust while the public is told that taxes pay for them. Unmasking the birth certificate scam provides the foundational clarity required to dissolve corporate legal jurisdiction and reclaim sovereign spiritual identity.
